findings.title: Domain has no discovery path: zero external mentions, zero backlinks, no Search Console or Bing registration
findings.evidence: WebSearch site:circuitcenter.ai -> zero results from the domain (only unrelated circuit*.ai companies). WebSearch "circuitcenter.ai" (quoted) -> zero pages on the web mention the domain; results are circuit.ai, circuitry.ai, circuitai.vercel.app. Zero mentions => assume zero backlinks => no crawler discovery path. Owner evidence 2026-08-31: GSC not registered, Bing Webmaster not registered ("No, neither"); owner paged many pages deep on Google for "circuit center" and the site never appears. Site live since ~2026-05-14, i.e. ~3.5 months with no discovery. NOT a robots/noindex defect: curl robots.txt allows all public routes, and served pages carry no noindex (only /search does, deliberately). ADDENDUM 2026-09-01 (post-GSC-verification): GSC URL Inspection shows the HOMEPAGE is already indexed ('URL is on Google', page indexed, HTTPS ok) — so the homepage's problem is ranking/authority for the brand term, not discovery. Zero external mentions, zero backlinks, and the unindexed deep pages remain true and open; GSC Pages report will quantify deep-page coverage in ~a day.
findings.fix: [OWNER] Register + verify circuitcenter.ai in Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools, then submit the sitemap (fix sitemap-exceeds-50000-url-limit FIRST or submission is rejected). [OWNER] Create the real external mentions that produce a crawl path: LinkedIn company page, Crunchbase, GitHub org, an industry directory listing. These are off-site actions; no repo change fixes this.

findings.title: sitemap.xml is a single 312,634-URL <urlset> — 6.25x the 50,000-URL protocol cap, so the whole file is rejected
findings.evidence: curl -s https://circuitcenter.ai/sitemap.xml | grep -c '<loc>' -> 312634. head -c 200 shows a bare <urlset>, not a <sitemapindex>. Uncompressed size 47,074,247 bytes (44.9 MB, under the 50MB cap but 6.25x over the URL cap). Serves in 4.9s (2.6MB gzipped on the wire). sitemap.py:116 emits one flat urlset with no cap; the part loop at ~line 101 does db.query(Part.id, Part.slug).all() with no limit. robots.txt advertises this file as the only sitemap, and it is the ONLY discovery path for part pages (see part-pages-orphaned-no-internal-links).
findings.fix: api/app/routes/sitemap.py:116 — emit a <sitemapindex> pointing at paged child sitemaps of <=50,000 URLs each (e.g. /sitemap-parts-1.xml). Given the domain currently has zero authority, cap the advertised part URLs to a tiered slice (the highest-value parts) rather than all 312k — six figures of URLs from a zero-mention domain reads spam-shaped and earns near-zero crawl budget. Align that cap with PRERENDER_PART_LIMIT (sitemap.py:147) so every advertised URL is one that actually prerenders.

findings.title: ~95% of advertised part URLs return HTML byte-identical to a nonexistent page — no title, no canonical, no h1, no schema
findings.evidence: Googlebot-UA fetch: /part/agq200s12z and /part/686720050001 both md5 70d845415f9e, 8291 bytes — IDENTICAL to /nonexistent-page-xyz (md5 70d845415f9e). That shell has title 'Circuit Center — The Integrated Circuits Directory' (same as a 404), 0 application/ld+json blocks, 0 <h1>, and NO <noscript> block at all. Random sample of 40 sitemap part URLs: 38 shell / 2 prerendered (95%). Arithmetic agrees: frontend/seo-manifest.json holds 14,937 parts vs 312,409 part URLs in the sitemap = 4.8% coverage. Parts INSIDE the manifest are correct (/part/cc0402krx7r7bb104 -> md5 b2ac121475c0, title 'CC0402KRX7R7BB104 by YAGEO — Buy from Distributors | Circuit Center', canonical + Product JSON-LD present). Not a data problem: /api/parts/by-slug/agq200s12z returns 200. Cause is the cap mismatch — PRERENDER_PART_LIMIT = 15_000 at api/app/routes/sitemap.py:147 vs an uncapped sitemap part loop. Category coverage is fine by contrast: sample of 25 category URLs -> 0 shell / 25 prerendered.
findings.fix: Make the sitemap's part slice and the prerender's part slice the SAME set. Either raise PRERENDER_PART_LIMIT (api/app/routes/sitemap.py:147) and regenerate frontend/seo-manifest.json via `node scripts/gen-seo-manifest.mjs`, or cap the sitemap to the prerendered slice (preferred at current authority). Note the committed manifest was generated 2026-08-30 from source 'http://localhost/api' with only 28 categories and 14,937 parts — regenerate it against PROD data, not local. Cost note: prerendering more routes grows build time and the static doc count; it adds no runtime dependency and no client bundle weight.

findings.title: No part page is reachable by any crawlable link — the raw-HTML link graph dead-ends at subcategory
findings.evidence: Parsed <a href> out of the Googlebot-served HTML at each hop. Home: 32 links, 25 of them /category/*. Category /category/power-management-ics-pmics: 6 links, all subcategories, ZERO matching /part/. Subcategory /category/power-management-ics-pmics/ldo-regulators: 2 links, both UP (/ and the parent). All 312,409 part URLs are therefore sitemap-only orphans, and the sitemap itself is rejected (see sitemap-exceeds-50000-url-limit). Orphaned pages in a sitemap still get ignored.
findings.fix: Add crawlable part links to the prerendered

findings.title: "circuit center" is owned by an established Pittsburgh event venue with an exact-match domain and heavy citations
findings.evidence: WebSearch "circuit center" first page is entirely The Circuit Center, a Pittsburgh wedding/event venue: circuitcenterpgh.com (exact-match domain), facebook.com/CircuitCenter, Yelp, The Knot, WeddingWire, Fever, 10times, thecommonplea.com. That is a real-world local entity with a physical address (5 Hot Metal St), a phone number, and years of third-party citations. circuitcenter.ai has zero mentions anywhere (see not-indexed-no-external-mentions), so it currently has no entity footprint to compete with. On-page entity signals ARE present and correct: served homepage carries Organization JSON-LD (@id https://circuitcenter.ai/#organization, name 'Circuit Center', crawlable logo at /images/apple-touch-icon.png -> HTTP 200) plus WebSite + SearchAction.
findings.fix: Do not chase the bare head term "circuit center" — it is not winnable against an entrenched exact-match-domain local entity, and the site is not even in the index yet. Target the disambiguated brand variants the owner can actually own: "circuit center ai", "circuitcenter.ai", "circuit center components", "circuit center electronic components directory". Winning those requires entity signals off-site (see organization-missing-sameas), not on-page changes. Secondary: the homepage <title> puts the brand LAST — 'The Integrated Circuits Directory — Compare Prices & Distributors | Circuit Center' (frontend/src/public/services/seo.ts). Leading the homepage title with the brand strengthens the brand-query match.

findings.title: Organization JSON-LD has no sameAs because no real Circuit Center profiles exist — the entity has nothing to resolve against
findings.evidence: Served homepage Organization JSON-LD contains name, url, logo, image, description, foundingDate and NO sameAs. Source frontend/src/public/services/seo.ts:20-21 documents this deliberately: 'sameAs is deliberately ABSENT: no verified Circuit Center social profiles exist yet.' Guard test at seo.test.ts:37 pins the omission. The CODE IS CORRECT — a fabricated sameAs would be worse. The gap is that no profiles exist to link, which is also why the quoted-domain search returns zero mentions.
findings.fix: [OWNER] Create real, owned profiles first — LinkedIn company page, Crunchbase, GitHub org — then wire their URLs into ORGANIZATION_JSONLD at frontend/src/public/services/seo.ts:24-36. Never invent a profile URL. This is the same action that fixes the zero-mentions problem, so it pays twice.

findings.title: og:image and twitter:image point at /images/og-default.png, which returns 404 on every page
findings.evidence: curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://circuitcenter.ai/images/og-default.png -> 404. The tag is on every served page (homepage: <meta property="og:image" content="https://circuitcenter.ai/images/og-default.png" />). The file does not exist in the repo either: frontend/public/images/ contains apple-touch-icon.png, favicon-*.png, favicon.ico, logo-badge-*.png, logo-lockup.png, logo-mark.svg, logo-monogram-mockup.png, site.webmanifest — no og-default.png. Referenced at frontend/index.html:42 (og:image) and frontend/index.html:46 (twitter:image).
findings.fix: Add frontend/public/images/og-default.png (1200x630) — logo-lockup.png is already in the repo and is the obvious source. Alternatively repoint frontend/index.html:42 and :46 at an existing asset. Every share of this domain currently renders a linkless grey card, which suppresses exactly the social pickup that would create the first external mentions.

findings.title: Organization schema claims foundingDate 2003 for a site that went live 2026-05-14
findings.evidence: Served homepage JSON-LD: "foundingDate":"2003". Source frontend/src/public/services/seo.ts:35. Owner evidence 2026-08-31: production went live ~2026-05-14. This is the same untrue claim CLAUDE.md records as already removed from the visible About strip ('a 23 Years Online that was never true') — it survived in structured data. Structured data that contradicts reality is a manual-action risk, the same class as Product/offers markup that disagrees with the page.
findings.fix: frontend/src/public/services/seo.ts:35 — set the real founding year or drop the property. An omitted foundingDate costs nothing; a false one is a liability.

findings.title: Prerendered pages carry only a <noscript> stub — 233-906 chars of crawlable text; subcategory copy is templated boilerplate
findings.evidence: Visible text with tags stripped (noscript RETAINED, scripts/styles removed): home 844 chars, category/power-management-ics-pmics 906, category/.../ldo-regulators 237, part/cc0402krx7r7bb104 233, /about 299, /bom 312, /join 322. All visible content lives inside <noscript>; the real body renders only after hydration. The 189 subcategory pages share one template — ldo-regulators reads 'Compare prices for Voltage Regulators (LDOs) components from top distributors on Circuit Center.' with only the name swapped, which is a duplicate-content signal at scale. Top-level categories are better: they carry the real Category.description prose (906 chars).
findings.fix: Extend frontend/scripts/seoPrerender.ts to write richer noscript bodies. Highest value: give subcategories real per-row description text (the same Category.description mechanism top-level categories already use, seeded via CATEGORY_DESCRIPTIONS in api/app/db/seed.py) instead of the shared template, and emit the parts list (which also fixes part-pages-orphaned-no-internal-links). Static markup only — no runtime dependency, no client bundle growth.

findings.title: Unknown URLs return HTTP 200 with the generic shell instead of 404
findings.evidence: curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://circuitcenter.ai/nonexistent-page-xyz -> 200, body md5 70d845415f9e (8291 bytes). Combined with part-pages-serve-generic-shell, that means ~297,000 advertised URLs and every typo/stale URL all return 200 with byte-identical content — a mass duplicate/soft-404 signal that wastes the crawl budget the domain does not yet have.
findings.fix: Have nginx serve the SPA fallback with a 404 status for unmatched paths (the React NotFoundPage at App.tsx:228 already renders correctly; only the status code is wrong). Lower value than the sitemap and prerender fixes and partially subsumed by them — do it after those.

findings.title: Meta/OG descriptions hardcode "170,000+" components against a live figure of 309,365
findings.evidence: curl -s https://circuitcenter.ai/api/stats/ -> {"parts":309365,"distributors":55,"categories":28,"subcategories":189}. The literal '170,000+' appears at frontend/index.html:26 (description), :40 (og:description), :45 (twitter:description) and frontend/src/public/services/seo.ts:122. Not a penalty risk — the claim is conservative and technically true — but it understates the catalog by 45% in the snippet that would appear in search results, and it is the exact stale-literal class CLAUDE.md requires be sourced from GET /api/stats/.
findings.fix: Regenerate the home description from the site_stats figure at build time (frontend/src/public/services/seo.ts:122 and frontend/index.html:26/40/45), or round to a durable band. Build-time substitution only — do not put a stats fetch in the request path.
